title: Genitive Basics and Prepositions
summary: Introducing genitive-focused forms and prepositions such as wegen and trotz.
whyItMatters: The genitive marks relationships between nouns and appears after common formal prepositions such as wegen and trotz.

mentalModel.title: Genitive answers whose or of what
mentalModel.content: The genitive noun phrase specifies ownership, association, or a larger whole.

mentalModel.title: Prepositions can govern case
mentalModel.content: Treat wegen and trotz as genitive packages in standard formal language.

ruleBlocks.title: Use des/der for definite genitive
ruleBlocks.content: Masculine and neuter use des; feminine and plural use der.

ruleBlocks.title: Add -s or -es to masculine and neuter nouns
ruleBlocks.content: Use des Kurses, des Semesters, and des Studiengangs.

ruleBlocks.title: Use genitive after wegen and trotz
ruleBlocks.content: Formal standard patterns include wegen des Problems and trotz der Frist.

ruleBlocks.title: Recognize dative in everyday speech
ruleBlocks.content: Colloquial German often uses dative after wegen; formal writing generally prefers genitive.

sentenceStructure: The genitive phrase follows the noun it specifies.
Masculine and neuter nouns usually carry an ending.
A prepositional phrase can begin the sentence; verb-second order remains.
Use formal genitive consistently in institutional writing.

comparisons.summary: Academic rules and institutions provide formal genitive contexts.
Semi-formal emails commonly explain delays with wegen or concessions with trotz.

examples.de: Die Inhalte des Kurses sind für mein Studium wichtig.
examples.en: The course content is important for my studies.

examples.de: Während des Semesters arbeite ich an zwei Projekten.
examples.en: During the semester I work on two projects.

examples.de: Wegen eines technischen Problems sende ich die Datei erneut.
examples.en: Because of a technical problem, I am sending the file again.

examples.de: Trotz der kurzen Frist habe ich alle Unterlagen eingereicht.
examples.en: Despite the short deadline, I submitted all documents.

examples.de: Das International Office der Universität beantwortet meine Frage.
examples.en: The university's international office answers my question.

commonMistakes.reason: Masculine and neuter nouns normally add -s or -es.

commonMistakes.wrong: wegen dem Termin in formal writing
Wegen des Problems ich schreibe Ihnen.
commonMistakes.correct: Wegen des Problems schreibe ich Ihnen.

tips: Learn article and noun ending together.
Practice each preposition with all genders.
